preserved_asset.method: Exact nearest-neighbor recovery of the user-selected pixels; no palette change

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this SELECTED kitten animation sheet, preserving the exact angular kitten design, readable face and eyes, light gray/off-white body, pink nose details, thin pixel outline, every existing pose and the8column10row arrangement. The user LIKES this design, DO NOT redesign it or replace it with a dark blob. Only clean the sprite edges: remove fuzzy gray/colored halos and stray colored pixels outside the characters. Keep crisp square pixels, thin clean contours and genuinely transparent empty background/gutters. No smooth shading or texture. Preserve complete ears, feet, tails and all face details. No labels or grid lines. Keep8columns x10rows, with each whole kitten centered inside its own cell and transparent padding.

Use case: style-transfer. Production pixel art animation sheet. The user SELECTED the attached art and rejected our attempts to simplify it into blobby dark silhouettes. Match this reference's crisp angular pixel art, readable face, thin outline, light gray body, clean separated pixels, restrained flat shading. Preserve the visual character of the references, no heavy contour, no dirty texture, no random specks, no fuzzy/colored halo.
ONE transparent sheet, 8 columns x 10 rows. Each animal is fully contained inside its cell with ample empty transparent margin. Same scale, anatomy and floor anchor throughout. No text, labels, grid or painted checkerboard. Art on a logical32x32 cell grid, enlarged with perfectly square nearest-neighbor pixels. Make each complete animal about18x17 logical pixels including tail; make eyes, ears, snout and tail readable. Palette gray/off-white/charcoal, optional tiny muted pink nose/ear. DO NOT eliminate eyes or merge large regions into solid black. Face must stay readable on both light and dark backgrounds.
Eight successive animation frames in every row, EXACT order:1idle blink/sniff,2groom,3look up,4stretch,5walk left,6run left,7SLEEP curled with eyes closed (all8frames sleeping),8curious,9celebrate,10relax. All10rows present. Motions different from cat poses.
Subject: ADULT PET RAT, not a cat. A clearly pointed snout and little nose, two round pixel ears, bead eyes, elongated pale-gray body, delicate feet, LONG THIN smooth tail (not bushy). Seated alert/sniffing for idle, low quick scurry for walking, stretched scamper for run, stand up sniffing for curious, little paw taps for celebrate, scratching round ear for relax. Look like the tiny minimal retro cat reference, but unmistakable rat anatomy.
